scope: Every paid reservation whose operation ID is a leased MA24 evaluation run contributes to one manifest-wide durable ceiling, including runs owned by different accounts.
enforcement: A before-insert trigger locks and increments the manifest cap row inside the same transaction as the paid-call reservation. Missing or exceeded caps, unknown cost bounds and inactive runs reject the insert before network send. Failed inserts roll back increments; settled or unknown bills do not release the conservative cap.
provisioningBoundary: The application role cannot insert or raise a cap row. No authorized cap row was created by this stage; a later G15 preflight must bind the exact reviewed limits, current tariffs, frozen inputs and paid authorization before calls can open.
